description: A global wildfire dataset for the analysis of fire regimes and fire behaviour is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Tomàs Artés et al. Global fire monitoring systems are used to study fire behaviour, fire regimes and their impact at the global scale. Although global fire products based on the use of Earth Observation satellites exist, most remote sensing products only partially cover the requirements for these analyses. Coverage: global; published in 2019. Formats: Shapefile. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4095 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
